teaser.en: Each clove is a flower bud picked before it could open, dried and shipped from the islands of Zanzibar and Pemba.
teaser.sw: Kila karafuu ni kichipukizi cha ua kilichochumwa kabla hakijachanua, kikakaushwa na kusafirishwa kutoka visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.
teaser.dg: Chila karafuu ni chimea cha ruwa chirichohundwa kabla ya kuvuguka, chikaanikpwa na kurehwa kpwa meli kula visiwa vya Zanzibar na Pemba.

summary.en: *Karafuu* is the clove, the dried flower bud of a tropical tree, imported from Zanzibar and Pemba. It spices pilau, tea and coffee.
summary.sw: *Karafuu* ni karafuu, kichipukizi cha ua kilichokaushwa cha mti wa kitropiki, kinachoagizwa kutoka Zanzibar na Pemba. Hukoleza pilau, chai na kahawa.
summary.dg: *Karafuu* ni chimea cha ruwa chirichoanikpwa cha muhi wa tsi za dzoho, chinachorehwa kula Zanzibar na Pemba. Nkutiywa *pilau*, chai na kahawa.

about.en: Cloves are the dried, unopened flower buds of an evergreen tree in the myrtle family. Each looks like a small brown nail, with a round head and a slender stem, and has a strong, warm, pungent scent.
about.sw: Karafuu ni vichipukizi vya maua vilivyokaushwa kabla ya kuchanua, vya mti usiopukutika wa familia ya mihadasi. Kila kimoja kinafanana na msumari mdogo wa kahawia, chenye kichwa cha mviringo na shina jembamba, na kina harufu kali ya joto na inayochoma.
about.dg: *Karafuu* ni vimea vya maruwa virivyoanikpwa, visivyovuguka, vya muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa jamii ya *myrtle*. Chila karafuu inahalana na msumari mdide wa rangi ya dongo, wenye chitswa cha mviringo na mlita mwembamba, na ina arufu kali na ya dzoho.

where.en: Cloves are not grown on the south coast; they are imported from Zanzibar and Pemba and sold in markets.
where.sw: Karafuu haipandwi pwani ya kusini; huagizwa kutoka Zanzibar na Pemba na kuuzwa sokoni.
where.dg: *Karafuu* tazirimwa pwani ya kusini; nkurehwa kula Zanzibar na Pemba na nkuguzwa cheteni.

uses.en: Cloves spice pilau, tea and coffee.
uses.sw: Karafuu hukoleza pilau, chai na kahawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *karafuu*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is clove.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *karafuu*, sawa na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *clove*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *karafuu*, dza ra Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza ni *clove*.

reason.sw: Jenasi moja; mzambarau wa majini (*water berry*)
Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa pilau
reason.dg: *Cinnamon*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa *pilau*

reason.en: Coffee, which cloves help to spice
reason.dg: *M'buni*, muhi wa kahawa, ambayo karafuu nkuipha ladha
